verdict.rationale: Vue's core design centers on single-file components encapsulating template/logic/style with reactive local state, and community feedback confirms ease of composing components (vue-comm-8, vue-comm-2, vue-comm-11) plus official ecosystem tools (router, vuex) for composing complex UIs (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13). Some caveats exist around complex-app scaling and state confusion (vue-comm-7, vue-comm-18, vue-comm-19, vue-comm-20), but the core capability is clearly delivered.
